# Oracle bump deltas: design-data 0.36.5 / data 3.15.1 to 0.62.1 / data 3.31.1

What the regenerated oracle fixtures say differently, per component, with a proposal for each. Nothing in the
components has been changed for these yet (a14.62). "Follow upstream" means Rune adopts the new oracle value;
"report" means ask upstream first. The raw old/new tables, generated by diffing `tests/fixtures/*.json` on
`main` against this branch, are the appendix.

Rune already reads the renamed tokens (`control_size_*`, `aspect_ratio_600`, `status_dot_size_*`), so a failing
test below is most likely a difference between what Rune computes from them and what the new oracle draws, not a missing token (not yet checked test by test).

## Status after the first part of slice 3

- Rows 2 and 3 (checkbox, switch): the failures were the test probes, not the components. The oracle puts odd-sized mobile L controls at half-pixel positions and `probe` rounded the edge outward; an edge at exactly .5 is now snapped like Rune does. Both pixel tests pass.
- Row 4 (action button): the recipe binds `base-height-*` for every size now, Rune used `component-height-*`; the two differ only at XS mobile (26 vs 25). Rune now reads `base_height_*`. Test passes.
- Row 5 (accordion): tests and regen script updated; the open item's content padding (10 + 15) is now pinned in the tests (`CONTENT_PAD`) because the oracle no longer draws it. Tests pass.
- Row 6 (status light desktop S, 8 to 10): Rune follows the data through the generated token, so its tests pass. Revert if upstream (#2046) decides on 8.
- Row 7 (wrap): checkbox, switch, radio and the rest pass. Status light has no wrapped case left because the 3.31.1 recipe never wraps its label (reported: adobe/spectrum-design-data#2047); its two wrap tests are `#[ignore]`d with that reason.
- Row 1 (radio button) is held for a decision: `control_border_and_dot_match_oracle` fails at mobile L (the control is 23 px, odd, in the oracle). Everything else in the suite passes.

## Summary and proposals

| # | Component | What changed in the oracle | Likely cause | Proposal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Radio button | Control is 2 px bigger at every size (desktop S/M/L/XL 12/14/16/18 to 14/16/18/20); mobile L and XL are 3 px bigger (20 to 23, 22 to 25). Label x moves with it. | The recipe now binds the generic `control-size-*` tokens instead of `radio-button-control-size-*`. | Follow upstream if you confirm radio and checkbox share a control size in S2. The +3 on mobile L/XL looks odd next to +2 elsewhere: confirm with design or report. |
| 2 | Checkbox | Mobile only: L box 22 to 23, XL box 26 to 25, with half-pixel y (13.5, 17.5) and label x 28 to 29, 32 to 31. Desktop unchanged. | Same generic `control-size-*` tokens; mobile L/XL values differ from the old checkbox-specific ones. | Follow upstream. Check that the half-pixel positions stay inside the 1 px test tolerance. XL getting smaller (26 to 25) is worth a glance. |
| 3 | Switch | Mobile only: L track 22 to 23 (radius 11 to 11.5), XL 26 to 25 (13 to 12.5); handle x shifts by half a pixel. | Same as the checkbox (`control-size-*`). | Follow upstream, same checks as the checkbox. |
| 4 | Action button | Mobile XS only: height 26 to 25, icon/label y 5 to 4.5, hold icon y 17 to 16. Focus rings follow (h 32 to 31). | A single recipe value changed for XS mobile. | Follow upstream (small). |
| 5 | Accordion | (a) Open items no longer draw content: the `content` part is gone, so an open item is 25 px shorter (e.g. M desktop 74 to 49) and divider/item heights shift with it. (b) The item sits in a fixed 240 px container with a container divider, no longer content-sized, so the title to actions gap grows (e.g. L desktop 46 to 62). (c) Parts renamed: `item` to `accordion-item`, `direct-actions` to `actions`. | Upstream recipe restructure. | Follow upstream for the recipe, and change the fixtures and tests (not the component): measure from `accordion-item`, drop the `content_pad` checks, and make the actions-gap test independent of the old content-sized item. Ask upstream whether `isOpen` is meant to have no visual now. |
| 6 | Status light | Desktop S dot 8 to 10 px (radius 4 to 5, label x 12 to 14, width 39.53 to 41.53). Mobile and M/L/XL are unchanged. | Desktop binds `ui-icon-*` (10 px small) but mobile binds `status-light-dot-size-*`: the same slot under two names. | Reported: adobe/spectrum-design-data#2046. Follow whatever they decide. The generator's alias table is a stopgap. |
| 7 | Wrap fixtures (checkbox, radio, status light, switch) | The request widths and label text the wrap script picks changed (e.g. status light M desktop 110 to 190 px, one line instead of two), plus the control sizes above. | Derived: `wrap.sh` measures the oracle; no independent upstream change. | No decision of its own. Re-check after rows 1 to 6 are settled. |

Unchanged: Badge, Button, Radio group (its fixtures differ only by the radio control size in row 1).
